subject: Req105 hiring committee: recommend no-hire & headcount reallocation plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Req105 hiring committee: recommend no-hire & headcount reallocation plan

Team —

Summary up front: after interviews and calibration with hiring manager, I am recommending we close Req105 (Senior Inference Engineer) with a "no-hire" decision and reallocate the committed headcount to two shorter-term priorities: one mid-level infra SRE and one contractor to support inference kernel tuning. Key reasons: candidate market mismatch to our band, the strongest candidate (Jordan Cole) expects comp above our calibrated band by ~18%, and we do not have a second-strong pool to validate moving the band.

Attached: req105-band-analysis.pdf and candidate-interview-notes-jcole.docx.

Proposed action (one-liner): committee approves no-hire, close req, notify recruiter/candidate, and open a new req for infra SRE (or convert to contractor) to capture near-term infra work.

Please reply with your OK / NO by EOD Monday 12/07. If you have an alternative (reband / internal-transfer / stretch-hire), call it out with suggested owner.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Inference Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: req105-band-analysis.pdf, candidate-interview-notes-jcole.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Req105 hiring committee: recommend no-hire & headcount reallocation plan

Markus —

Thanks for the summary and the analysis. Two quick clarifying Qs before I cast a vote:

1) What is the exact delta between our top-of-band and the candidate's ask (total comp cadence — base + equity)? Your note says ~18% but we need the breakdown for finance.
2) Is there any credible flexibility from the hiring manager to repurpose some scope (e.g., accept a weaker infra experience in exchange for strong model work) so we can justify a band stretch?

If we cannot show business case for stretch, I am inclined to support no-hire and reallocate. Finance will need the compensation table.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent & Hiring Committee Chair
Redwood Inference

Quick vote from me: NO HIRE.

Rationale: interview feedback was consistent — candidate has strong ML inference background but lacks the systems/ops depth we need for L6 senior role. We could pursue Jordan on a 6-month contractor if hiring manager wants short-term ramp help (I think that's feasible).

If committee agrees, I can action closing the req and trigger recruiter communication. Also: recommend we create req110 (infra SRE, L5) instead of trying to stretch the band for Req105.

Marissa

I agree with Marissa's recommendation to close and reallocate. Two operational notes:

- Before we close, explore internal lateral conversion: any internal L5 who could step into an accelerated L6 stretch? HR data suggests two strong internal ICs in ML infra who might be open. If so, we can avoid external re-hire and promote. Laura / Talent, can you do a quick scout?
- If internal conversion is not viable, I support converting headcount into one L5 infra SRE and one 0.5 FTE contractor (contractor budget from recruiting reserve). Finance will need a short memo — I can take point if we have approval.

Vote: NO HIRE (committee consensus).

Subject: Req105 committee closeout: actions & notification plan

Thanks all — consensus captured: NO HIRE for Req105. Closing notes and action items below (final):

1) Close Req105 in Greenhouse today and mark disposition: "No hire — band mismatch / scope misalignment." I will update req105-closeout-action-items.txt and attach.
2) Marissa: please notify our external recruiter (Avery Talent) and inform candidate Jordan Cole that we are not proceeding for the L6 role; offer to keep candidate warm for contract work if they're interested. Suggested email template attached in the closeout file.
3) Laura: quick internal scout for two L5 candidates (internal transfers) — please report back by 12/10.
4) Vivek: prepare a one-page memo to Finance for headcount reallocation (convert to L5 infra SRE + 0.5 FTE contractor). Deadline 12/11.
5) Markus: update hiring manager and close loop on interview debriefs.

I'll archive interview feedback and the band analysis in the hiring folder. Thanks for the quick turn.

Mina Haddad
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
